verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm that a root llms.txt (HTTP 200 at neon.com/llms.txt), a docs llms.txt index, and per-page .md docs are live. A dedicated Management API llms.txt also returns HTTP 200 and links per-endpoint .md pages and the OpenAPI spec. Agent-addressed docs go further: auth.md is a provisioning runbook written for agents, alongside SKILL.md agent skills and a 'get started with an agent' guide.
